schema.name: timestamp
schema.description: Five-minute source timestamp from KPX. Parquet stores timestamp[ns]; CSV uses YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS text. No timezone is asserted.

schema.name: source
schema.description: Measurement family: demand, dispatch, or state_estimation. This field determines the semantic meaning of value_mw.

schema.name: generator_id
schema.description: Source-native KPX generator CODE for dispatch/state_estimation; blank/null for system-level demand rows.

schema.name: value_mw
schema.description: MW value. demand = demand forecast; dispatch = economic-dispatch BASEPOINT; state_estimation = state-estimated generator output.
